test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper bought 12 dozen eggs at the rate of Rs. 5 per egg. 12 eggs broke in transit. He sold the remaining eggs at the rate of Rs. 6 per egg. Find his percentage of profit.
solution:
**Given**

Number of eggs bought = 12 dozen = 12 × 12 = 144 eggs

Cost price per egg = Rs. 5

Number of eggs broke = 12

Selling price per egg = Rs. 6

**Formula Used**

Total Cost Price (CP) = Number of units × Cost per unit

Total Selling Price (SP) = Number of units sold × Selling price per unit

Profit = SP - CP
